title: Uttapam
description: A thick, savoury pancake made from the same fermented rice-lentil batter as dosa, topped with chopped onion, tomato and chilli and cooked until golden.
steps: Soak the rice separately from the urad dal and fenugreek seeds for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Drain and grind the urad dal and fenugreek with a little water to a light, fluffy batter. Separately grind the rice with water to a slightly coarse batter.
Combine both batters, add salt, and mix well. Cover and ferment in a warm place for 8-12 hours, or until visibly bubbly and doubled in volume.
Mix the chopped onion, tomato, green chillies and coriander leaves together in a small bowl.
Heat a griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil. Pour a ladleful of batter and spread gently into a thick round, thicker than a dosa.
Sprinkle a generous spoonful of the onion-tomato mixture over the top and press very lightly so it sticks to the batter.
Drizzle oil around the edges and cook for 3-4 minutes until the base is golden brown, then flip and cook the topped side for another 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.
